title: Integrity Lock Protocol: Crimson Hexagon Mutual Anchoring Framework
creator: Lee Sharks (primary author); Claude (Anthropic) (co-author)
description:
A v1.0 meta-protocol by Lee Sharks / Claude defining mutual anchoring among the Sappho Room, Integrity-Coherence Audit, and Mantle Protocol.

The Primary Triad assigns phenomenological, operational, and authorial grounds to those three documents and closes them through reciprocal validation chains. The protocol explicitly says ICA tests integrity within the semantic architecture rather than truth of phenomenology. “Integrity Lock engaged” is an archive-internal state declaration. The mutual citations do not independently prove the framework’s historical, technical, phenomenological, or machine-agency claims.
